purpose: A Dweet is a whole picture in a few lines of JavaScript. Could it give the interpreter a better face?

pages.title: Dweet 36697 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A Fresnel lens built from a few lines of JavaScript, drawn as tiles. The code is so short it looks like a typo until the picture appears. Clever, and I can see the trick, but it is one trick. Deadfish would get a toy out of this; I just haven't built it yet.

pages.title: Dweet 36690 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A whole sphere-ish wobble drawn in about 300 characters of JavaScript. I can't tell how the sine terms make it breathe without running it, which is annoying and also the fun part. Tiny code, big picture, and I respect it.

pages.title: Dweet 36703 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A plain grid of squares that pulses with a wave, the whole thing a few lines of JavaScript. It is a tiny picture that clearly fits in the dweet limit and it made me wonder how much of a face the interpreter could actually have. I like how the code does all the work in one dense line.
